fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles and debris to allow emergency vehicles to reach the front entry.
• Trim vegetation along the driveway edges so responders can move between their vehicles and the front entry without obstruction.
• Cut back dense vegetation near the detached structure to allow responders to approach and work around all sides of it.
• Clear a walking path from the front of the property to the rear so responders are not forced to push through dense vegetation to reach the back of the lot.
• Keep any gate or passage leading to the rear of the property unlocked and free of overgrown vegetation.
• Mark the location of the detached structure with a sign or number visible from the driveway so arriving responders know a second structure is on the property.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that overhang or touch the roof and walls of the house.
• Thin the tree clusters surrounding the house to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants growing directly against the house on all sides.
• Thin shrubs and small trees along the driveway so vehicles can pass without branches scraping the sides or roof.
• Keep the driveway clear of overhanging branches so fire trucks and emergency vehicles can reach the house without obstruction.
• Trim low branches off trees near the house to raise the canopy above the roofline and walls.
• Separate shrubs and plants near the house from nearby trees so fire cannot easily travel from the ground into the tree tops.
• Thin the dense tree clusters closest to the house so the area around the structure stays open and visible.
• Remove dead branches, fallen limbs, and dry leaf or needle buildup from the ground beneath trees near the house.
• Keep the open green space clear of dead or dry plant material that could carry fire toward the house.
• Cut back vegetation at the entrance of the driveway so the opening is clearly visible and easy to enter quickly.
• Thin scattered trees near the house to widen the open space between the tree line and the structure on all sides.
